comment: SosrG v3 design tokens — cream/gold light theme, superseding the v2 navy dark theme (see redesign.md §1 changelog). Canonical source per redesign.md §11 (app-readiness for a future native app). src/design-system/tokens.css must be kept in sync with these same values by hand — the token set is small enough that a codegen step would be overhead, not a safeguard.

color._light_theme_note: Values measured by sampling the real mobile app screenshots (pixel-sampled with Pillow, same discipline redesign.md §1 used for the logo), then contrast-verified against cream-100 (page bg) with the same relative-luminance method: text-primary 15.33:1, text-muted 6.74:1, gold-700 4.67:1, danger 5.15:1, success 4.5:1, tier-yellow 5.12:1, tier-blue 4.91:1 — all pass AA (4.5:1 body text). gold-500 itself is NOT used as text on cream (2.34:1, fails) — only as a fill, exactly mirroring why v2 needed a separate gold-700 for text-on-light.
color._tier-color-note: Green/Red account tiers reuse success/danger. Yellow/Blue are dedicated tokens per redesign.md §1's own escape hatch for a genuinely-needed second accent — both re-darkened from their v2 values, which were tuned for a dark navy background and fail badly on cream (old tier-yellow 1.85:1, old tier-blue 2.19:1).

shadow._comment: Neumorphism shadow-tinting rule unchanged from v2 (redesign.md §2): never pure black/white. Recalibrated for a light cream base — warm umber-brown for the dark side (not black), a warm near-white for the light side (not pure white), faint gold tint on the pressed/inset-light state.

breakpoint.comment: Mobile (320-480px) is the unqueried default per redesign.md §4 — these three are min-width thresholds

headingSettle.comment: redesign.md §3/§5 — Fraunces variable-axis motion primitive, the platform's one repeatable typographic effect (load+shimmer for the hero only, scroll for other section headings, hover/focus for interactive card titles).

focusRing._comment: v2 used gold-300 (a light highlight) because it needed to stand out on dark navy. On the cream base that's now the page background, a light gold ring is nearly invisible — gold-700 (the deep, text-on-light gold) is the correct analog: same accent hue, recalibrated for which end of the scale actually contrasts against the new surface.

spacing.comment: No custom spacing scale defined — Tailwind v4's default scale (p-1..p-32 etc.) already produces exactly the 4/8/12/16/24/32/48/64/96/128px scale specified in redesign.md §4, so component code just uses Tailwind's built-in spacing utilities directly.
